plain: The Antikythera mechanism is, as Jesse Michels describes it, a small ancient device that worked almost like a computer, built around astronomical alignments and found in a shipwreck in the Aegean Sea. Michels brings it up himself in several episodes without naming a source, as an example of ancient technology more advanced than you would expect. Once he places the find on a Greek island instead of a shipwreck and points to a book called Forbidden Archaeology.
